app_authorization_use_account: Sign in to {app} with your CoForge account, in a Workspace where it is installed.
app_authorization_app_help: Where you go once you continue.
app_authorization_workspace_help: Pick the Workspace to use the app in. Only Workspaces where it is installed are listed.
app_authorization_access_intro: Continuing gives {app} exactly what is listed here, and nothing more.
app_authorization_group_identity_summary: who you are and your basic profile, not your content
app_authorization_scope_openid: Signs you in and gives the app a lasting identifier for your account.
app_authorization_scope_profile: Your name as CoForge shows it. Not your messages, files or Agents.
app_authorization_scope_identity: Whether a person or an Agent is signing in, and the Workspace they act in with their role there. No content.
app_authorization_scope_email: The email address of your account. Not your messages, files or Agents.
app_authorization_failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
app_authorization_invalid_missing_client: The link doesn't say which app it's from. Go back to the app and start signing in again.
app_authorization_invalid_unknown_client: The app that sent you here isn't registered with CoForge. Go back to the app and start signing in again.
app_authorization_invalid_redirect_uri: The app sent you from an address it hasn't registered with CoForge, so you won't be sent back there. Go back to the app and start signing in again.
app_authorization_expired_description: The page waited too long, or no longer matches your session. Go back to the app and start signing in again.
app_authorization_unavailable_descriptio: It isn't installed in any Workspace you are a member of.
app_authorization_get_access_body: Ask the people who provide {app} to add you to a Workspace where it is installed.
app_authorization_faq_what_body: It lets you use other apps with your CoForge account, inside one of your Workspaces. This page shows what an app receives before you decide.
app_authorization_faq_register_title: How does an app get registered?
app_authorization_faq_register_body: Owners and admins of a Workspace register apps in its settings. An app registered there is installed in that Workspace.
app_authorization_faq_agent_title: Can my Agent use this app?
app_authorization_faq_agent_body: Not through this page: it is for people signing in. An Agent gets its own access to an app through CoForge, never with your account.
